1050.description: A standing calf raise under the Smith bar with the balls of your feet on a block. The block lets you stretch deeper.
instructions: Place a block under the Smith bar and rest the bar on your upper back.
Stand with the balls of your feet on the block.
Lower your heels for a full stretch.
Rise onto your toes as high as you can.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.

1178.description: A one-leg calf raise holding a dumbbell for a challenging calf workout.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and stand on one foot on a step.
Hold a wall or rail with your other hand for balance.
Lower your heel to a full stretch.
Press up onto your toes as high as possible.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

1242.description: A crunch on a bosu ball. The unstable surface asks more from your core.
instructions: Sit on the bosu ball and lie back so it supports your lower back.
Place your hands lightly behind your head.
Curl your shoulders up by contracting your abs.
Hold the top briefly.
Lower slowly and keep your feet planted.

1306.description: A push-up that you drive explosively so your hands leave the floor. It builds fast pressing power in the chest, shoulders and triceps.
instructions: Start in a high plank position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lower your chest towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping your body in a straight line.
Push explosively off the ground, using your chest muscles to propel your upper body off the ground.
Land softly with your hands back in the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 从高平板支撑位置开始，双手分开略宽于肩宽。
弯曲肘部，将胸部压向地面，保持身体呈一条直线。
爆发性地推离地面，利用胸部肌肉将上半身推离地面。
双手回到起始位置，轻轻落地。
重复所需的重复次数。

1370.description: Stand with a barbell across your back and raise onto your toes from the floor. It works the calves, with the full range limited to flat ground.
instructions: Place a barbell on the floor in front of you.
Stand with the balls of your feet on the edge of the barbell, with your heels hanging off.
Hold onto a stable object for balance if needed.
Raise your heels as high as possible, using your calves to lift your body.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将杠铃放在您面前的地板上。
站立，脚掌放在杠铃边缘，脚跟悬垂。
如果需要，请抓住一个稳定的物体以保持平衡。
尽可能高地抬高脚后跟，用小腿来抬起身体。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1434.description: A low bar squat on the smith machine, with the bar sitting lower on the back. It builds the glutes, quads and hamstrings along a fixed bar path.
instructions: Set up the smith machine with the barbell at a height that allows you to comfortably rest it on your upper back.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly turned outwards.
Step under the bar and position it across your upper back, resting it on your traps.
Grip the bar with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Unrack the bar by straightening your legs and stepping back from the rack.
Take a deep breath and brace your core.
Initiate the squat by pushing your hips back and bending your knees.
Lower your body until your thighs are parallel to the ground or slightly below.
Keep your chest up and your back straight throughout the movement.
Drive through your heels to stand back up, extending your hips and knees.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将史密斯机与杠铃设置在一个高度，以便您可以将其舒适地放在上背部。
站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，脚趾稍微向外转动。
走到杠铃下方，将其放在上背部上方，将其放在斜方肌上。
双手握住杠铃，距离略大于肩宽。
伸直双腿并从架子上退后，将杠铃松开。
深呼吸并支撑你的核心。
通过向后推臀部并弯曲膝盖来开始深蹲。
降低身体，直到大腿与地面平行或稍低于地面。
在整个动作过程中保持挺胸、背部挺直。
通过脚后跟站起来，伸展臀部和膝盖。
重复所需的重复次数。

1498.description: A decline sit-up with a band adding resistance. It trains the abs through a long range.
instructions: Anchor a band behind you and hold the other end at your chest.
Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured.
Curl your torso up toward your knees, keeping tension on the band.
Pause at the top without pulling on your neck.
Lower back down slowly under control.

1562.description: A squat with a stability ball between your back and the wall. The ball keeps the movement smooth and supports your back.
instructions: Place a stability ball between your lower back and a wall.
Walk your feet forward about a step and stand shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees and let the ball roll down your back as you squat.
Lower until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Press through your heels to rise back up.

1626.description: A reverse grip, close grip decline bench press in the smith machine. It works the chest and triceps.
instructions: Adjust the smith machine to a decline position.
Lie down on the bench with your feet secured under the foot pads.
Grasp the barbell with a close grip, slightly narrower than shoulder-width apart.
Unrack the barbell and lower it slowly towards your chest, keeping your elbows tucked in.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push the barbell back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将史密斯机调整至下降位置。
躺在长凳上，双脚固定在脚垫下。
紧紧握住杠铃，握距略窄于肩宽。
松开杠铃，慢慢将其降低到胸部，保持肘部内收。
在底部停顿片刻，然后将杠铃推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1754.description: A bench dip with extra weight added for more resistance. Builds triceps and front shoulder strength once bodyweight gets easy.
instructions: Sit on the edge of a bench with your hands gripping the edge, fingers pointing forward.
Walk your feet forward, sliding your butt off the bench and supporting your weight with your arms.
Lower your body by bending your elbows, keeping your back close to the bench.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push yourself back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳边缘，双手抓住边缘，手指指向前方。
双脚向前走，将臀部滑离长凳，并用手臂支撑体重。
弯曲肘部降低身体，使背部靠近长凳。
在底部暂停片刻，然后将自己推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1818.description: Hanging from a bar with palms facing you stretches the biceps and forearms. Let your body weight do the lengthening.
instructions: Grip a pull-up bar with an underhand, shoulder-width grip.
Let your body hang with your arms straight, relaxing your shoulders downward.
Take as much weight through your legs as you need to stay comfortable.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1882.description: Floor stretch that pulls one leg across the body to open the outer hip.
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight.
Bring one knee up and across your body.
Use the opposite hand to ease it toward the floor.
Keep your shoulders flat on the ground.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

1946.description: A standing stretch drawing one knee up and in to open the hip and glutes.
instructions: Stand tall, holding a wall or support for balance.
Lift one knee and hold the shin and ankle with both hands.
Pull the leg gently toward your chest and slightly across the body.
Keep your standing leg soft and your back straight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

2138.description: Steady pedalling on a stationary bike at a pace that suits you. Builds endurance and leg conditioning.
instructions: Adjust the seat height and position to ensure proper alignment.
Place your feet on the pedals and secure them with the straps if available.
Start pedaling at a comfortable pace.
Maintain a steady rhythm and increase the resistance as desired.
Engage your core muscles to maintain stability and proper posture.
Continue pedaling for the desired duration of your workout.
Gradually decrease the resistance and slow down before coming to a complete stop.
Stretch your legs and cool down after the workout.
instructionsZh: 调整座椅高度和位置以确保正确对齐。
将脚放在踏板上，并用带子（如果有）将其固定。
以舒适的速度开始踩踏板。
保持稳定的节奏并根据需要增加阻力。
调动核心肌肉以保持稳定性和正确的姿势。
继续踩踏板达到所需的锻炼时间。
逐渐减小阻力并减速，然后完全停止。
锻炼后伸展双腿并放松。

2202.description: A roller-assisted hip opener for the glutes. Helps loosen tight hips with a controlled rolling motion.
instructions: Start by sitting on the ground with your legs extended in front of you.
Place the roller under your glutes, just above your knees.
Lean back and place your hands on the ground behind you for support.
Engage your glutes and slowly roll the roller forward, bending your knees and bringing them towards your chest.
Pause for a moment at the end of the movement, feeling a stretch in your glutes.
Slowly roll the roller back to the starting position, extending your legs.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 首先坐在地上，双腿在身前伸展。
将滚轮放在臀部下方、膝盖上方。
向后倾斜，双手放在身后的地面上以获得支撑。
收紧臀部，慢慢向前滚动滚轮，弯曲膝盖并将其拉向胸部。
动作结束时暂停片刻，感受臀部的拉伸。
慢慢地将滚轮滚回起始位置，伸展双腿。
重复所需的重复次数。

2266.description: A machine back extension that strengthens the muscles along the lower back with support from the pad.
instructions: Adjust the machine and sit with your back against the pad.
Cross your arms or hold the handles as the machine allows.
Push back by extending at the hips and lower back.
Stop when your torso is in a neutral, tall position.
Return slowly to the start.
Repeat for the planned reps.

2330.description: A cable lat pulldown using the full range of motion. Builds the lats and upper back.
instructions: Sit on the lat pulldown machine with your knees positioned under the pads.
Grasp the cable bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lean back slightly and keep your chest up, maintaining a slight arch in your lower back.
Pull the bar down towards your upper chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the movement, then slowly release the bar back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在高位下拉机上，膝盖位于护垫下方。
正手握住电缆杆，握距略宽于肩宽。
稍微向后倾斜，挺胸，保持下背部轻微的拱形。
将杠铃向下拉至上胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作底部暂停片刻，然后慢慢松开杠铃回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

2394.description: A floor-based back extension that strengthens the glutes and lower back.
instructions: Lie face down with your arms extended or by your head.
Squeeze your glutes and lift your chest and legs slightly off the floor.
Keep your neck neutral and look at the floor.
Pause at the top for a second.
Lower slowly to the floor.
Repeat without forcing a big arch.

2458.description: A squat-to-throw movement with a medicine ball that conditions the whole body.
instructions: Stand facing a wall holding a medicine ball at your chest.
Squat down with your chest up.
Drive up powerfully and throw the ball to a target on the wall.
Catch the ball as it returns.
Flow straight into the next squat.
Keep a steady rhythm.

2714.description: A hold with a heavy weight in each hand, arms held out to the sides, building shoulder and grip endurance.
instructions: Pick up a weight in each hand and stand tall.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Hold them there with a braced core.
Keep your shoulders down and avoid shrugging.
Hold as long as you can, then lower under control.

2778.description: Raising the arm forward and up in front of the body, working the front of the shoulder.
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall with your arms at your sides, palms facing in.
Raise one arm forward and up to about shoulder height or higher.
Keep your ribs down, then lower slowly.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

2842.description: A rolling Pilates move in a seated crab shape that works the core and spine mobility.
instructions: Sit with your legs crossed and hold your feet.
Roll back onto your shoulders.
Cross your legs the other way.
Roll back up.
Keep your movement smooth.

2906.description: Walking backward while dragging a power sled. Great for quads and conditioning with low joint stress.
instructions: Face the sled, holding its handles or straps with a slight lean back.
Keep your chest up and core braced.
Walk backward in steady steps, pulling the sled with you.
Keep your knees soft and drive through your legs.
Cover a set distance, then rest.

2970.description: A squat into an overhead press using a band for resistance. It trains the legs, shoulders and heart in one move.
instructions: Stand on the band and hold the ends at your shoulders.
Squat down with your chest up.
Drive up and press your hands overhead in one motion.
Lock out your arms at the top.
Lower your hands to your shoulders and repeat.

3034.description: From all fours, you drive one bent knee up toward the ceiling. It targets the glutes without any equipment.
instructions: Start on hands and knees with your hands under your shoulders.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Lift one leg with the knee bent at 90 degrees.
Push the sole of your foot toward the ceiling and squeeze your glute.
Lower slowly without arching your back.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

3162.description: A standing one arm row from a hip hinge, pulling a weight toward your chest one side at a time. Good for the upper back and lats.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, knees slightly bent, and hold a dumbbell in one hand.
Bend forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Let the dumbbell hang straight down in front of you, with your arm fully extended.
Pull the dumbbell up towards your chest, keeping your elbow close to your body.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top of the movement.
Lower the dumbbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，膝盖稍微弯曲，一手握住哑铃。
臀部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
让哑铃垂直悬挂在您面前，手臂完全伸展。
将哑铃向上拉向胸部，保持肘部靠近身体。
在动作的最高点将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。

3226.description: A face-down hold where you lift your chest with your palms tucked under your thighs. It builds lower back and upper back endurance.
instructions: Lie face down with your palms under your thighs.
Keep your neck long and look at the floor.
Lift your chest off the ground using your back muscles.
Squeeze your glutes.
Hold for 15-30 seconds.
Lower slowly and rest.

3290.description: An advanced one arm pull-up with added weight. It builds the lats and biceps and needs great pulling strength.
instructions: Grab the pull-up bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Hang from the bar with your arm fully extended and your body straight.
Engage your core and pull your body up towards the bar by bending your elbow and squeezing your back muscles.
Continue pulling until your chin is above the bar.
Lower your body back down to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 正手握住引体向上杆，握距略宽于肩宽。
悬挂在杠上，手臂完全伸展，身体伸直。
弯曲肘部并挤压背部肌肉，调动核心力量，将身体拉向杠铃杆。
继续拉，直到下巴位于杠铃上方。
有控制地降低身体回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3354.description: A second take on the cable front squat, holding the handle at your chest to stay upright and hit the quads.
instructions: Set the cable low and hold the handle against your chest.
Stand with feet shoulder width apart.
Sit down into a deep squat, chest tall.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Press through your heels back to standing.

3418.description: A pull-up with the legs held out straight in an L shape. It trains the lats, biceps and core.
instructions: Grab the pull-up bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Hang with your arms fully extended and your body straight.
Engage your lats and biceps to pull your body up towards the bar, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Continue pulling until your chin is above the bar.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 正手握住引体向上杆，握距略宽于肩宽。
双臂完全伸展，身体伸直。
收紧背阔肌和二头肌，将身体拉向杠铃杆，保持肘部靠近身体。
继续拉，直到下巴位于杠铃上方。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将身体放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3482.description: A high lunge with the arms driving like a sprinter's. It builds leg strength, balance and hip stability.
instructions: Stand tall and step one foot well back into a staggered stance.
Bend both knees and lower into a lunge, back heel lifted.
Swing the arm opposite the front leg forward and the other arm back, like sprinting.
Keep your torso upright and the front knee over the ankle.
Push through the front foot to rise, then repeat all reps.
Switch legs and do the same number.

3546.description: A seated dumbbell shoulder press with the arms alternating. It trains the delts and triceps.
instructions: Sit on a bench with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing inwards, and raise them to shoulder height.
Press one dumbbell up overhead while keeping the other dumbbell at shoulder height.
Lower the raised dumbbell back to shoulder height while simultaneously pressing the other dumbbell up overhead.
Continue alternating between arms for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，背部挺直，双脚平放在地上。
双手各握一个哑铃，掌心向内，将哑铃举至肩高。
将一个哑铃举过头顶，同时将另一个哑铃保持在与肩同高的位置。
将举起的哑铃放回肩高，同时将另一个哑铃推过头顶。
继续交替手臂进行所需的重复次数。

3674.description: A side-view form check showing a correct standing posture.
instructions: Stand with feet hip width apart.
Keep your ears over your shoulders and hips.
Keep a natural curve in your lower back.
Relax your arms.
Compare yourself to the correct posture.

3738.description: A bench press with one kettlebell at a time, adding stability demand for the shoulder and core.
instructions: Lie on a bench holding a kettlebell above your chest.
Keep your wrist straight and your feet planted.
Lower the bell to the side of your chest.
Press it back up to full extension.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

3866.description: A dead bug with a band pulling you sideways, so your core works hard to keep your torso from twisting.
instructions: Anchor a band at the side and lie on your back, holding the band above your chest with both hands.
Raise your knees to a tabletop position.
Brace your core so the band does not pull you sideways.
Slowly extend one leg and the opposite arm back.
Return and switch sides.
Keep your lower back flat on the floor.

3930.description: A plank where your feet jump apart and together like a jumping jack. It trains the core and raises your heart rate.
instructions: Start in a forearm or high plank with your body in a straight line.
Jump both feet out wide.
Jump them back together.
Keep your hips level and your abs tight throughout.
Continue for the planned reps or time.

3994.description: Gentle circles of the head to loosen the neck. It eases stiffness in the neck muscles.
instructions: Stand or sit tall with relaxed shoulders.
Drop your chin toward your chest.
Slowly roll your head to one side.
Continue in a smooth circle.
Do 5 circles, then reverse.

4058.description: Advanced core move where the body stays straight while you raise and lower the legs from a bench. It strongly trains the abs.
instructions: Lie on a bench and grip it behind your head.
Lift your hips and legs so your body is straight from shoulders to toes.
Keep your body rigid and lower slowly without sitting.
Raise your legs back up under control.
Stop before your lower back arches.

4122.description: A single arm reverse fly on a cable to isolate the rear delts.
instructions: Stand sideways to a cable at shoulder height and grab the handle with the far hand.
Keep a slight bend in your elbow.
Pull your arm across and back in an arc.
Squeeze your rear delt.
Return slowly, then switch arms.

4186.description: A squat with a band held overhead. It improves mobility and leg strength.
instructions: Stand on the band and hold it overhead with wide grip.
Brace your core.
Squat down keeping arms overhead.
Keep your chest up.
Drive up through your feet.
Keep your arms in line with your ears.

4250.description: A V-up holding a dumbbell, raising your torso and legs together. It trains the whole abdominal wall.
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight, holding a dumbbell overhead.
Brace your core.
Lift your legs and torso together, reaching the dumbbell toward your feet.
Form a V at the top.
Lower slowly with control.
Keep your lower back pressed down.

4314.description: A gentle back stretch draped over or kneeling at a stability ball. It lengthens the spine and relaxes the torso.
instructions: Kneel in front of a stability ball and place your forearms or hands on top.
Roll the ball forward as you sink your hips back.
Let your head drop between your arms and lengthen your spine.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing deeply.
Roll the ball back in to come up.

4378.description: A plate-loaded machine row with an underhand grip that trains the lats and upper back while the biceps assist.
instructions: Sit at the machine with your chest against the pad and grab the handles underhand.
Set your shoulders back and down.
Pull the handles toward your lower ribs, driving your elbows back.
Squeeze your back at the end of the pull.
Slowly extend your arms without letting your shoulders round forward.

4442.description: A single-leg squat with the rear foot raised on a bench and a hand lightly holding a support for balance. Trains quads and glutes with less wobble.
instructions: Stand facing away from a bench and hold a sturdy post or rack with one hand for balance.
Place the top of your rear foot on a bench behind you.
Step your front foot far enough forward to stay balanced.
Lower straight down until your front thigh is about parallel to the floor.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee tracking over your toes.
Drive through the front heel to stand, then switch legs after your set.

4506.description: A kneeling plank with alternating shoulder taps. Trains anti-rotation core control and shoulder stability.
instructions: Start on hands and knees, then lift your knees slightly into a kneeling plank.
Keep a straight line from head to knees.
Lift one hand and tap the opposite shoulder.
Place it back down without rocking your hips.
Alternate sides at a steady pace.
Keep your abs tight throughout.

4570.description: A two-handed bent-over band row with palms facing in, hitting the lats and mid-back.
instructions: Stand on the band with feet hip-width apart and hinge forward.
Hold the handles with a neutral grip, arms straight.
Keep your back flat and neck neutral.
Pull both handles toward your lower ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower with control.

4634.description: A running-in-place drill that alternates a high knee with a heel kick to raise your heart rate.
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Drive one knee up to hip height.
Lower it and kick the same heel toward your glutes.
Alternate sides at a steady, light pace.
Keep your core braced and stay on the balls of your feet.

4698.description: A bent-over row with a band. It builds the upper back and lats.
instructions: Stand on the band and hold the ends, hinging forward with a flat back.
Let your arms hang straight down.
Row your elbows back toward your hips.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly and repeat.

4762.description: A hip extension on a glute ham developer. You hinge at the hips with a straight body to work the glutes and hamstrings.
instructions: Set up on the GHD with your feet planted and hips just past the pad.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Lower your torso by hinging at the hips with a flat back.
Squeeze your glutes to raise back to a straight line.
Do not arch past neutral at the top.

4826.description: Lying on your back, you raise one leg at a time. It works the lower abs and hip flexors.
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your legs straight and arms at your sides.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Raise one leg up toward the ceiling.
Lower it slowly while lifting the other leg.
Keep alternating without arching your back.

4890.description: A glute ham raise performed with the arms stretched out in front, making the lift harder. It strongly trains the hamstrings and glutes.
instructions: Set up on the glute ham bench with your ankles locked in and thighs supported.
Extend your arms straight out in front of you.
Lower your torso toward the floor with a straight body.
Squeeze your hamstrings and glutes to pull yourself back up.
Stop when your body is in a straight line.
Move slowly and avoid arching your lower back.

5146.description: Hang from a bar with your body leaning back to stretch your lats and shoulders.
instructions: Hold a bar with an overhand grip.
Lean your body back and let your arms and shoulders lengthen.
Relax your ribs and breathe slowly.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Step out of the stretch carefully.

5274.description: A crunch where your knees pull in as your chest comes up. It trains the abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs extended just off the floor.
Place your hands behind your head.
Pull your knees in and crunch your chest toward them.
Squeeze your abs at the top.
Extend and lower slowly.

5402.description: A lunge combined with a stick held overhead. Opens the hip flexors of the back leg and the shoulders at the same time.
instructions: Hold a stick in both hands and step into a long lunge.
Lower your back knee toward the floor while keeping your torso upright.
Raise the stick overhead with straight arms.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling the stretch at the front of the back hip.
Step back and repeat on the other leg.

5466.description: A plank where you lift an arm and the opposite leg. Challenges your core stability.
instructions: Start in a forearm or high plank with your body in a straight line.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes.
Lift one arm forward and the opposite leg back.
Hold for a couple of seconds.
Return and switch sides.
Keep your hips level.

5658.description: Seated rope face pull for the rear delts.
instructions: Sit facing a cable with a rope attachment.
Sit tall.
Pull the rope toward your face.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Return slowly.

5914.description: A low plank with elbows hugged by your sides. Builds strength in the arms and core.
instructions: Start in a high plank.
Shift slightly forward on your toes.
Bend your elbows straight back and lower.
Keep your body straight like a plank.
Hold briefly, then press back up.

5978.description: A walking stretch where you kick straight legs up toward outstretched hands, warming up the hamstrings and hips.
instructions: Stand tall with your arms stretched out in front of you.
Kick one straight leg up toward your hands.
Lower it and step forward.
Kick the other leg up.
Keep your chest upright and walk for about 10 reps per side.

6042.description: A one-legged hip hinge holding weighted bottles. It works the hamstrings and glutes and challenges balance.
instructions: Stand on one leg holding a bottle in each hand, with a slight bend in the knee.
Hinge at the hips and extend the free leg straight behind you.
Lower the bottles toward the floor with a flat back.
Squeeze your glute to return to standing.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

6234.description: A bodyweight curl using gymnastic rings. It builds the biceps.
instructions: Hold the rings and lean back.
Extend your arms.
Curl your hands toward your head.
Keep your elbows up.
Lower slowly.
Keep your body in a straight line.

6298.description: A wheel pose with one leg lifted into the air. It adds balance and strength demand to the backbend.
instructions: Come into wheel pose with hands and feet pressing down.
Shift weight onto one foot.
Lift the other leg toward the ceiling.
Keep your hips high and level.
Hold briefly, lower, then switch legs.

6362.description: Standing reverse wrist curls with dumbbells to strengthen the extensor muscles on top of your forearms.
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing down.
Keep your upper arms still.
Lift the backs of your hands up by extending your wrists.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

6554.description: A sit-up on a glute ham bench. The extra range of motion works the abs and hip flexors hard.
instructions: Set your feet under the pads of a glute ham bench, hips on the support.
Cross your arms over your chest and lean back to a comfortable depth.
Brace your abs and curl up until your torso is upright.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly under control.
Keep your lower back from over-arching at the bottom.

6618.description: A yoga low lunge with the back knee down and arms overhead. It opens the hips and stretches the front of the thigh.
instructions: Start in a lunge with the front knee over the ankle.
Lower the back knee to the floor and untuck the toes.
Sink your hips forward and down.
Raise both arms overhead and lift your chest.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Step back and switch legs.

6746.description: A seated ankle move turning the foot inward against a cable. It strengthens the inner ankle and lower leg.
instructions: Sit with your leg extended and a cable cuff on your foot.
Position the cable so it pulls the foot outward.
Keep your leg still.
Turn the sole of your foot inward against the cable.
Pause, then return slowly.
Finish the reps and switch feet.

6810.description: A lying knee raise against band resistance. It builds the lower abs and hip flexors.
instructions: Lie on your back with a band looped around your feet or anchored.
Place your hands by your sides and brace your core.
Bring your knees toward your chest against the band.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower your feet slowly without arching your back.

7194.description: A quick hopping drill that crosses the feet and steps back, building agility and leg power.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your knees soft.
Hop and cross one foot in front of the other.
Hop back out, then step one foot back behind you.
Land softly on the balls of your feet each time.
Keep a quick, rhythmic pace.
Alternate sides for the planned time.

7578.description: Front squat holding a V bar on a low cable.
instructions: Hold a V bar at chest height.
Stand a step back from the cable.
Squat down with your elbows up.
Keep your chest tall.
Stand up.

9690.description: A front squat with a dumbbell and raised heels, which keeps your torso upright and puts the work on the quads.
instructions: Place your heels on small plates and hold a dumbbell at your chest.
Brace your core and keep your elbows up.
Sit down into a deep squat.
Keep your chest tall and knees tracking over toes.
Drive up to stand.

10138.description: A static curl hold where you keep the elbows bent and the biceps working without moving.
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip width apart and your elbows at your sides.
Bend your elbows to about 90 degrees with palms facing up.
Squeeze your fists and flex your biceps hard.
Hold the position for 20-30 seconds, breathing steadily.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and elbows pinned, then rest and repeat.

10330.description: A side-lying raise that targets the rear shoulder with a long range of motion.
instructions: Lie on your side on a bench holding a light dumbbell in your top hand.
Start with the arm hanging in front of your body.
Raise the arm out and back in an arc until it is in line with your torso.
Pause briefly, then lower with control.
Use a light weight and switch sides after your set.

10650.description: A push-up with a band across your back and a fast push at the top. It trains explosive chest and triceps power.
instructions: Loop the band across your upper back and hold the ends under your palms.
Set up in a push-up position with a straight body.
Lower your chest to the floor with control.
Push up hard so your hands briefly leave the floor.
Land softly with elbows slightly bent.
Keep your hips in line.

10906.description: A held split stance that opens the front of the hip and loads the front thigh.
instructions: Step one foot far forward and the other back into a split stance.
Lower your hips until the front knee is bent to about 90 degrees.
Keep your torso upright and your front heel down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing steadily.
Rise up and switch legs.

0026.description: A barbell squat with a bench behind you as a depth target. Trains the quads and glutes.
instructions: Set up a barbell on a squat rack at chest height.
Stand facing away from the rack, with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees and lower your body down into a squat position, keeping your back straight and chest up.
Grasp the barbell with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lift the barbell off the rack and step back, ensuring your feet are still shoulder-width apart.
Lower your body down into a squat, keeping your knees in line with your toes.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将杠铃放在深蹲架上，与胸部同高。
背对架子站立，双脚与肩同宽。
弯曲膝盖，将身体降低至蹲姿，保持背部挺直，挺胸。
正手握住杠铃，握距略宽于肩宽。
将杠铃从架子上提起并向后退一步，确保双脚仍与肩同宽。
降低身体蹲下，保持膝盖与脚趾在一条线上。
在底部停顿片刻，然后推动脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0090.description: A seated good morning with the bar on your back. Trains the lower back and glutes.
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and a barbell resting on your upper back.
Keep your back straight and your chest up.
Slowly hinge forward at the hips, lowering your torso towards the ground.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，上背部放一个杠铃。
保持背部挺直，挺胸。
慢慢地向前转动臀部，将躯干降低到地面。
在底部停顿片刻，然后推动脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0154.description: A reverse fly using crossed cables. Targets the rear delts and upper back.
instructions: Attach a D-handle to each low pulley cable and stand in the middle of the cable crossover machine.
Grasp the handles with a pronated grip (palms facing down) and take a step forward, positioning your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees slightly and lean forward at the waist, keeping your back straight and your abs engaged.
With your arms extended out to the sides and slightly bent at the elbows, exhale and squeeze your shoulder blades together as you pull the cables back and upward in a reverse fly motion.
Pause for a moment at the peak contraction, then inhale and slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将 D 形手柄连接到每根低滑轮电缆上，并站在电缆交叉机的中间。
旋前抓住手柄（手掌朝下），向前迈出一步，双脚分开与肩同宽。
稍微弯曲膝盖，腰部前倾，保持背部挺直，腹部收紧。
双臂向两侧伸展，肘部稍微弯曲，呼气并将肩胛骨挤压在一起，同时以反向飞翔动作向后和向上拉动绳索。
在收缩峰值时停顿片刻，然后吸气，慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0218.description: A seated cable row with a wide grip handle. The wide hold puts more emphasis on the upper back and rear shoulders.
instructions: Sit on the cable row machine with your feet flat on the footrests and your knees slightly bent.
Grasp the handle with a wide overhand grip, palms facing down.
Keep your back straight and lean slightly forward from the hips.
Pull the handle towards your lower chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the peak of the contraction.
Slowly release the handle back to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在电缆划船机上，双脚平放在脚踏板上，膝盖稍微弯曲。
正手宽握握住手柄，手掌朝下。
保持背部挺直，并从臀部稍微向前倾斜。
将手柄拉向下胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在收缩高峰时暂停片刻。
慢慢松开手柄回到起始位置，充分伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。

0282.description: A sit-up on a decline bench with the feet secured. The slope makes it harder and works the abs and hip flexors.
instructions: Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured and your knees bent.
Place your hands behind your head or across your chest.
Engage your abs and lift your upper body off the bench, curling forward towards your knees.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 躺在倾斜的长凳上，双脚固定，膝盖弯曲。
将双手放在脑后或放在胸前。
收紧腹肌，将上半身抬离长凳，向前向膝盖弯曲。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0346.description: Lying on a bench, you extend one arm overhead with a palm-up grip to hit the back of the upper arm. A focused way to build triceps one side at a time.
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with your back and head supported, and your feet flat on the ground.
Hold a dumbbell in one hand with an underhand grip, and extend your arm straight up above your shoulder.
Keeping your upper arm stationary, slowly lower the dumbbell behind your head by bending your elbow.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then extend your arm back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
instructionsZh: 平躺在长凳上，背部和头部得到支撑，双脚平放在地面上。
一只手握住哑铃，反握，将手臂伸直至肩膀上方。
保持上臂静止，弯曲肘部，慢慢将哑铃降低到脑后。
在底部停顿片刻，然后将手臂伸回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

0410.description: A split squat with a dumbbell where the rear foot is raised or the body shifts to one leg. It builds the thighs and glutes and challenges balance.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Take a step forward with one foot and position your feet so that your front foot is flat on the ground and your back foot is elevated on a bench or step.
Lower your body by bending your front knee and hip, keeping your back knee slightly bent and your back heel off the ground.
Continue lowering until your front thigh is parallel to the ground, then push through your front heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs and repeat.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，每只手各握一个哑铃。
一只脚向前迈出一步，调整双脚的位置，使前脚平放在地面上，后脚抬高在长凳或台阶上。
弯曲前膝盖和臀部，降低身体，保持后膝盖稍微弯曲，后脚跟离开地面。
继续降低，直到大腿前部与地面平行，然后通过前脚跟推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换腿并重复。

0474.description: Hanging from a bar, you lift your straight legs and raise the hips. It trains the lower abs.
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with your arms fully extended and your palms facing away from you.
Engage your core and lift your legs up in front of you until they are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 悬挂在引体向上杆上，双臂完全伸展，手掌背向自己。
启动你的核心并将双腿抬起到你面前，直到它们与地面平行。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0538.description: Dip and drive with your legs to throw a kettlebell from the shoulder to overhead with one arm. Builds explosive shoulder and leg power.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell in one hand at shoulder height.
Bend your knees slightly and engage your core.
Press the kettlebell overhead in a straight line, fully extending your arm.
As you press the kettlebell overhead, simultaneously dip your knees and quickly straighten them to generate momentum.
As the kettlebell reaches its highest point, quickly drop underneath it by bending your knees and hips.
Catch the kettlebell with a slight bend in your knees and hips, and your arm fully extended overhead.
Stand up straight, fully extending your knees and hips, and stabilize the kettlebell overhead.
Lower the kettlebell back to the starting position by bending your knees and hips, and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，一只手握住壶铃，与肩同高。
稍微弯曲膝盖并启动核心。
将壶铃沿直线压过头顶，充分伸展手臂。
当你将壶铃举过头顶时，同时弯曲膝盖并快速伸直以产生动力。
当壶铃到达最高点时，弯曲膝盖和臀部，快速落到壶铃下方。
膝盖和臀部稍微弯曲，抓住壶铃，手臂完全伸过头顶。
站直，充分伸展膝盖和臀部，并将壶铃稳定在头顶上。
弯曲膝盖和臀部，将壶铃放回起始位置，然后重复所需的重复次数。

0602.description: Chest against the pad, you pull the handles back and out in a wide arc. Targets the rear delts and upper back.
instructions: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your chest against the pad and your feet flat on the floor.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip and keep your arms slightly bent.
Exhale and squeeze your shoulder blades together as you pull the handles back and outward, away from your body.
Pause for a moment at the peak contraction, then inhale and slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整座椅高度，将自己放在机器上，胸部靠在垫子上，双脚平放在地板上。
正手握住手柄，并保持手臂稍微弯曲。
呼气并将肩胛骨挤压在一起，同时向后和向外拉动手柄，使其远离身体。
在收缩峰值时停顿片刻，然后吸气，慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0666.description: A push-up where you lift one arm out to the side at the top. Challenges the core and shoulder stability.
instructions: Start in a push-up position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and your feet together.
Extend one arm straight out to the side, parallel to the ground.
Lower your body towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping your back straight and core engaged.
Push back up to the starting position, using your chest muscles to lift your body.
Repeat with the other arm extended.
instructionsZh: 从俯卧撑位置开始，双手分开略宽于肩宽，双脚并拢。
将一只手臂伸直至一侧，与地面平行。
弯曲肘部，将身体降低到地面，保持背部挺直，核心参与。
推回起始位置，使用胸部肌肉抬起身体。
另一只手臂伸出，重复上述动作。

0730.description: Standing on one foot on a slide board, you slide your other leg back and forth. Works the legs and glutes with a balance challenge.
instructions: Start by standing with one foot on a platform or slide board.
Bend your knee slightly and slide the foot on the platform backward, extending your leg.
Keep your core engaged and maintain a straight posture throughout the movement.
Slowly return to the starting position by sliding your foot back to the initial position.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
instructionsZh: 首先将一只脚站在平台或滑板上。
稍微弯曲膝盖，将脚向后滑动到平台上，伸展腿。
在整个运动过程中保持核心参与并保持笔直姿势。
将脚滑回初始位置，慢慢返回起始位置。
重复该动作达到所需的重复次数，然后换腿。

0794.description: A standing side bend that stretches the lats and the muscles along the side of the torso. It loosens up the sides and improves mobility.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Extend your arms straight out to the sides, parallel to the ground.
Slowly lean your upper body to one side, feeling a stretch in your side and lats.
Hold the stretch for 15-30 seconds.
Return to the starting position and repeat on the other side.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，膝盖稍微弯曲。
将双臂伸直至两侧，与地面平行。
慢慢将上半身向一侧倾斜，感觉侧面和背阔肌有拉伸感。
保持拉伸 15-30 秒。
返回起始位置并在另一侧重复。
重复所需的重复次数。

0858.description: Short, all-out runs followed by rest. They build speed, stamina and a strong cardio base.
instructions: Find an open space or a track to perform the exercise.
Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Begin running as fast as you can, pumping your arms and driving your knees up.
Continue sprinting for a specific distance or time period.
Rest and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 找一个空地或跑道来进行练习。
首先站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
开始尽可能快地跑步，挥动手臂并抬起膝盖。
继续冲刺特定的距离或时间。
休息并重复所需的重复次数。

0986.description: A standing one-arm curl with the arm held overhead against band tension. It trains the biceps.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and place one end of the band under your foot.
Hold the other end of the band with your arm fully extended overhead, palm facing forward.
Keeping your upper arm stationary, curl your forearm towards your shoulder, squeezing your biceps.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your forearm back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将弹力带的一端放在脚下。
握住弹力带的另一端，手臂完全伸过头顶，手掌朝前。
保持上臂静止，将前臂向肩膀弯曲，挤压二头肌。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将前臂放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。
